home.name: how_it_works
home.title: How it works
home.text: ODIN utilizes state-of-the-art eye-tracking software to capture precise ocular metrics during our assessments, which are then fed into our advanced machine-learning algorithms for accurate and comprehensive user evaluation.

home.name: pitch
home.title: Revolutionizing Concussion Care Across All Ages
home.text: Experience the future of concussion care with ODIN’s advanced, data-driven assessments. Our objective evaluations provide unbiased, precise results empowering medical professionals with the crucial information needed for informed decision-making. Protect the well-being of athletes at every level with technology that sets a new standard in sports safety.
